subject: Post-demo: consumption runway, surge windows & $/1M target
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@luminacare.ai>, Rob Ellis <rob.ellis@lumina.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: consumption runway, surge windows & $/1M target

Hi Sara / Rob —

Thanks again for the product walkthrough this morning — good to see the preview of the patient-summary flow. A quick recap and a couple of concrete asks so we can get a hosted pricing sketch over to legal/finance:

1) Expected monthly token run-rate (typical production month). Please give a best estimate and a high/low range if you have it.
2) Peak/surge windows: what are the short-lived peaks (minutes) and the sustained spikes (hours)? For each, approximate the observed or expected peak tokens-per-second (TPS) and duration.
3) Target $/1M tokens (your preferred price band) or monthly budget band for the hosted API. If you have an internal budget range, that helps us shape options (dedicated vs hosted).
4) Average tokens per request (or per conversation) and percent of calls that stream vs non-streaming — that affects instance sizing.

If you can reply with ballpark numbers by Monday (9/28) we’ll put together 2 pricing options: 1) hosted API baseline with auto-fallover and 2) hosted + burst reserve windows for promotional spikes.

Attached: small CSV template to drop in monthly token slices if you want — helps ensure our burst-calcs align with your telemetry.

Quick next step: I’ll tentatively schedule 30 minutes on Wed to walk the pricing sketch (if that works for you).

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment: LuminaCare_consumption_snapshot.csv (CSV, 8KB)

From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@luminacare.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rob Ellis <rob.ellis@lumina.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: consumption runway, surge windows & $/1M target

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the clear ask. Below are our current estimates (internal ops telemetry + pilot signals). These are intended to be conservative-ish — happy to refine with the template attached.

- Typical month (baseline): 120,000,000 tokens/month (this excludes batch jobs).
- High/Low: 90M — 150M tokens/month.
- Average tokens per request: ~350 tokens (most calls are a short prompt + concise summary).
- Streaming vs non-streaming: ~20% streaming, 80% non-streaming
- Sustained spikes (hours): product release windows and morning syncs — 99th percentile ~450 TPS sustained for ~2 hours.
- Short peaks (minutes): campaign-driven spikes — measured transient peaks up to ~700 TPS for bursts of 3–8 minutes.
- Budget target: our procurement team is looking at $/1M tokens in the ~$8–$12 range; internal upper bound for hosted is ~$1,500/mo initially.

Notes: we can reduce averages by truncating context on certain templates, but that would impact summary quality. The pilot telemetry I can share is attached as a CSV export.

Happy to hop on Wed.

Sara Kim
Head of Product | LuminaCare
sara.kim@luminacare.ai

Attachment: pilot_token_snapshot.csv (CSV, 42KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Sara Kim <sara.kim@luminacare.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rob Ellis <rob.ellis@lumina.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: consumption runway, surge windows & $/1M target

Thanks Sara — this is great. A couple of follow-ups so our engineering/ops sizing is accurate:

- For the "99th percentile ~450 TPS sustained for ~2 hours" row: is that measured in tokens/sec or requests/sec? (we assume tokens/sec but want to confirm).
- For the short peaks up to ~700 TPS: what fraction of those requests are streaming? Streaming requests have longer open connections and affect concurrent connection capacity.
- Can you confirm the distribution across regions? Are most users US-east, or do you have a split with EU that would change routing?

If you can reply inline, we’ll incorporate into the hosted pricing sketch. I’ll also attach a concise pricing sketch (pdf) that shows the math (unit $/1M * tokens + peak provisioning assumptions) so you can see how the numbers map to dollars.

–Karthik
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-hosted-pricing-sketch.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@luminacare.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rob Ellis <rob.ellis@lumina.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: consumption runway, surge windows & $/1M target

Quick clarifications (inline):

- 99th percentile figure is in tokens/sec.
- Short peak bursts: ~70% non-streaming, ~30% streaming (mostly preview endpoints).
- Region: ~85% US (primarily us-west/us-east), ~10% EU, ~5% APAC.

Procurement note: $8–$12 / 1M tokens is the current expectation; if Redwood can offer staged pricing (lower $/1M after a 3-month ramp) that would help. We also want to understand if there’s a separate per-connection concurrency limit or just TPS-based throttles.

Jordan — Wed works for us at 11am PT. If you want, propose calendar invite and we’ll accept.

Thanks,
Sara
